items.title: Preparing for the Frailty and Dementia Modern Service Framework
items.summary: Preparing for the Frailty and Dementia Modern Service Framework Date 28 September 2026 The Ten Year Health Plan for England, published in July 2025, committed to the development of Modern Service Frameworks (MSFs) to drive improvement across different areas of health.

items.title: Chair and Deputy Chair of the BGS Nurse and Allied Health Professions Council announced
items.summary: Chair and Deputy Chair of the BGS Nurse and Allied Health Professions Council announced 28 September 2026 The British Geriatrics Society (BGS) is pleased to announce that Dr Susanne Arnold PhD has been appointed as the next Chair of the BGS Nurse and Allied Health Professions (NAHPs) Council.

items.title: “Stepping forward together”: How pharmacists across all sectors are shaping healthier futures for older people
items.summary: “Stepping forward together”: How pharmacists across all sectors are shaping healthier futures for older people Date 24 September 2026 Mina Hunjan and V-Lin Cheong are Co-Chairs of the BGS Pharmacy Professionals Group. Mina is a Clinical Pharmacist in Warwickshire East Primary Care Network.

items.title: Empowering the next generation of pharmacists: Reflecting on the MED-AGE Summer Research Placement Programme
items.summary: Empowering the next generation of pharmacists: Reflecting on the MED-AGE Summer Research Placement Programme Date 24 September 2026 World Pharmacists Day on 25 September provides an opportunity each year to celebrate pharmacists and their crucial role in healthcare.

items.title: Right here, right now: Be part of the ultimate falls prevention squad
items.summary: Right here, right now: Be part of the ultimate falls prevention squad Date 22 September 2026 Dr Alasdair MacRae is a Consultant Geriatrician at the Royal Alexandra Hospital in Paisley. He is the Chair of the BGS Falls and Bone Health SIG Committee.
